authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W02 authority/policy + W03 durability + W04-H accepted control/capability outputs
defaults.mission: Deterministic target-neutral execution boundary: ActionIntent -> current Policy/Authority -> target resolution -> safeguards -> execute -> readback -> Receipt/Evidence -> reconcile uncertainty, with circuit breaker and kill switch.

tasks.title: W07-00 Executor Plane Coordination & Boundary Freeze
actions: Revalidate W01-W04/W02 accepted outputs and W07 prerequisites.
Freeze W07 ownership, package/service paths, shared-surface locks and internal DAG.
Freeze ActionIntent consumption and compatibility-safe target-neutral Receipt/Evidence evolution.
Define publication barriers for W08/W09/W14/W15 consumers.
Create risk register, premortem, load/failure and acceptance plans.
tasks.ownership: W07 governance, executor-owned contracts/services and coordinator-controlled publication surfaces.
tasks.forbidden: No runtime feature code, provider adapters, Android runtime, n8n runtime or business-domain decisions.

tasks.title: W07-A ExecutionTargetReference & Target Kinds
actions: Define versioned ExecutionTargetReference for PROVIDER, DEVICE, WORKFLOW and LOCAL_SERVICE.
Define target identity/reference semantics without fake provider IDs or W14 DeviceId ownership leakage.
Evolve canonical ActionIntent/Receipt/Evidence compatibility-safely with old provider fixtures preserved.
Add contract/schema/property/consumer tests and fail closed on conflicting legacy/new target references.
tasks.ownership: execution-target contracts/schemas plus explicitly listed compatibility files in W07 ownership freeze
tasks.forbidden: No DeviceId/DeviceRef, provider adapter logic, device session/trust or external execution.

tasks.title: W07-B Executor SDK & Current Policy/Authority Validation
actions: Implement deterministic Executor SDK consuming canonical ActionIntent.
Require current policy/authority validation whenever operation semantics require it and fail closed on invalid authority.
Prove Fast Lane, confidence, precheck and ExecutionBudget cannot bypass validation.
tasks.forbidden: No token issuance, second Policy Engine, provider adapter or confidence/precheck authorization.

tasks.title: W07-C Idempotency, Preconditions, Quotas & Deadlines
actions: Integrate generic idempotency key/ledger behavior with W03 primitives.
Implement explicit preconditions, quotas, deadline/expiry and bounded-attempt semantics.
Fence duplicate commands before external call and add deterministic concurrency/race tests.
tasks.forbidden: No second W03 ledger and no provider-specific rate-limit or business budget policy.

tasks.title: W07-D ExecutionTargetResolver
actions: Resolve target references to executable generic target bindings deterministically.
Validate availability/freshness/compatibility/preconditions and return canonical non-execution outcomes for stale/unavailable/ambiguous bindings.
Prove target resolution never grants authority.
tasks.forbidden: No side effect execution, provider adapter or device/workflow session runtime.

tasks.title: W07-E Receipt, Evidence & Readback Semantics
actions: Implement generic target-neutral execution Receipt/Evidence production and readback interface.
Capture requested action, observed result, timestamps, target reference and uncertainty without secrets.
Add schema parity/readback mismatch tests; acknowledgement alone never proves verified state.
tasks.forbidden: No W17 telemetry platform and no provider/device credential material in evidence.

tasks.title: W07-F EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN & Reconcile-Before-Retry
actions: Model EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN separately from ordinary failure.
Detect timeout/connection-loss cases where a side effect may have occurred.
Implement reconcile-before-retry, prohibit blind retry and fault-inject ambiguous state.
tasks.forbidden: No hiding uncertainty as FAILED and no blind retry.

tasks.title: W07-G Circuit Breaker, Kill Switch & Failure Containment
actions: Implement bounded circuit breaker, degradation, kill switch and safe cancellation primitives.
Define outage/repeated-failure/overload/cascading-retry behavior and governed recovery.
Prove kill switch cannot be overridden by model/router/agent output.
tasks.forbidden: No W17 SLO platform and no intelligence override path.

tasks.title: W07-H Executor Integration, Fault Injection & Consumer Publication
actions: Integrate A-G with W02 current validation, W03 idempotency/event foundations and W04 capabilities.
Run W08/W09/W14/W15 mock consumer fixtures without implementing consumer-wave runtime.
Fault-inject duplicate, timeout, stale authority/target, readback mismatch, circuit open and kill switch.
Run four Risk Gates and exact-head Quality/Test Build/Security, then publish accepted public surfaces.
tasks.ownership: W07 integration/fault-injection tests, evidence and publication handoff only
tasks.forbidden: No new semantic runtime and no consumer-wave/provider/device/workflow implementation.
